# CAND-RF-01

Fictional candidate part for tests. SPDT, 0.05 to 6.0 GHz.

## Specifications

| Parameter | Typ | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| Insertion loss at 2.4 GHz | 0.50 | dB |
| Port-to-port isolation at 2.4 GHz | 27 | dB |
| VDD range | 1.8 to 3.3 | V |

Package: QFN-12 2x2 mm.
